methodology: Identity-only universe expand batch 6. Prefer lsp-plugins + x42 + calf + dragonfly-reverb + audiority + singular-sound + NI/Spitfire soundsets. New mfrs: audiority, cfa-sound, singular-sound, lsp-plugins, x42, calf, dragonfly-reverb, eq10q, zam-audio, guitarix. LSP families collapsed (no Mono/Stereo/LR/MS explosion). FOSS first-class with OAS also_check where twins exist. Large-mfr fills: Waves bundles, IK AmpliTube collections + ARC/AXE/TONEX hardware (iOS/iRig flood skipped), UA Apollo + C-Suite + collections. Spitfire Originals 2026 + ARO section fills as soundset. Modartt denser Pianoteq 6–8 gens. cableguys/goodhertz/melda/softube/rc-20/excite already dense — skipped. No invented versions. No git clone.
